data.name: Hentai Cameraman
data.description:
🌀 **SOMEWHERE BETWEEN THE ABSURD, THE SURREAL AND THE PSYCHEDELIC, A DIFFERENT FREQUENCY BEGINS TO EMERGE.**

This November, PULSE SOCIETY opens another portal into the unconventional.

Taking the helm is **HENTAI CAMERAMAN** — bringing their distinctive, eccentric sonic universe to the dancefloor. An exploration into the stranger territories of psychedelic electronic music, where familiar structures dissolve into unexpected patterns, peculiar grooves and surreal sonic narratives. Unorthodox in spirit and unapologetic in expression, their musical language invites you to abandon expectations and surrender to the unpredictable. This is not about following a formula; it's about venturing beyond it.

Accompanying this descent is a carefully assembled constellation of artists, each bringing their own interpretation of psychedelic expression.

**GOBLIN CHAOS** — unleashing twisted frequencies and untamed psychedelic energy.

**SVAAHA** — navigating the deeper, darker corridors of psychedelic sound, weaving intricate textures and hypnotic rhythmic journeys.

**JUNGLE QUEEN** — bringing an untamed sonic character to the gathering.

**IGNIA** — adding another dimension to the psychedelic spectrum.

**TRIPPIN MONK** — joining the expedition with a journey into the unconventional.

Presented by **PULSE SOCIETY** in association with **PRALAYAH RECORDS**.

An assembly of sound, imagination and underground culture. No boundaries to conform to, no expectations to fulfil — just a dancefloor where individuality, experimentation and sonic exploration take precedence.

🐉 **PULSE SOCIETY presents: HENTAI CAMERAMAN**

📅 27 NOVEMBER 2026  
📍 OCEAN PIRATES, ANJUNA, GOA

🎟️ Tickets available on all major platforms.

**COME FOR THE FREQUENCIES. STAY FOR THE DESCENT.**

#pulsesociety #psychedelicmusic #goaunderground #psytrance #anjunagoa

data.name: Maleficus Noctis
data.description:
translated from Latin, Maleficus Noctis brings together two ideas: the malevolent or mischievous, and the night. A rather fitting name for two days that aren't quite going to follow the usual script.

We're bringing two different worlds to D'Pedro Quarry this December, each with its own character, atmosphere and musical direction.

19 DECEMBER | DAY 01
MEADOWS OF THE DARK

The first night is dedicated to the darker end of the psychedelic spectrum, with artists exploring darkpsy, forest and much more. Expect a journey through shadowy territories, dense atmospheres and psychedelic explorations that will fire up every neuron you've got.

A night dedicated to the stranger, darker side of psychedelia.

20 DECEMBER | DAY 02
POST MODERN MUSIC LABEL SHOWCASE

The following night takes a different turn. Post Modern brings its musical universe to the quarry, with a showcase dedicated to unconventional electronic sounds, experimentation and artists who enjoy taking the less travelled route.

We'd like you to be part of this little detour from the ordinary.

19 & 20 DECEMBER
D'PEDRO QUARRY

data.name: Perseverance Festival
data.description:
Psyrituals , Akkadian Project Presents - Perseverance Festival

 📆 26 - 28 December 2026

VENUE -📍 D Pedro , Goa

PERSEVERANCE FESTIVAL
26th - 27th December 2026 • Goa

In Collaboration with @_akkadianproject & @psyrituals.records

The time has come to start a new chapter.

Dedicated to the details that matter most — a precisely engineered sound system, where artists who have persevered with their craft for decades and more will weave conceptual music into a journey that transcends us to the core of our inner beings.

With visionary art that connects us to higher subtle dimensions, sacred fire performances to ignite our inner flame and reveal our path of self-discovery…

Perseverance Festival is for the dreamers, the wanderers, the seekers, and the visionaries — for those who walk the edge between worlds, who hear the call of the wild jungle and the pulse of the cosmos, who refuse to dim their inner light.

It is a sanctuary for the souls brave enough to surrender, to dance through the shadows and the stars, to dissolve the boundaries between self and universe.

Let the fire awaken ancient truths. Let the visions guide you home.

Under the same eternal sky, we endure. We transform. We rise.

This is Perseverance.

data.name: UNMADA VARA  NYE - The Pulse of Prāṇa
data.description:
Unmada Vara: The Pulse of Prāṇa

Last time, we stepped into the blessing of madness — into intensity, into letting go, into something raw and real.

This time, we go deeper.

The Pulse of Prāṇa is about the life-force that moves through everything — through sound, through people, through moments that stay with you long after they pass. It’s not about escaping… It’s about feeling more. Being more present. More alive.

Unmada Vara has always been about coming together with intention — not just to celebrate, but to reset, reconnect, and return to something real within ourselves.

This New Year’s, we gather again — for that shared pulse you can’t quite explain, only feel.

Tickets are now live on all platforms.

Tier 2 is priced at INR 4,000/-.

The line-up, as always, will never disappoint — worth the wait. Announcements coming soon.

We come together on 31st December 2026 into 1st January 2027 for a New Year’s Eve gathering to reset mind, body, and soul.
